purpose: Convention for composing plugins from SKILLs and custom Agents: naming, launch routes, selection order, defense layers, skill invocation, and waiting for Agent completion, independent of any project.
summary: Naming rules: use short route names, never bare "subagent", valid subagent_type values only
Launch routes: isolated-context work goes to custom Agents; fork-type SKILLs are avoided by default
Selection order: Bash subprocess, general-purpose Agent, custom Agent, then inherited SKILL
Inherited SKILL rule: do not paste parent context into $ARGUMENTS or Agent prompts
Custom Agent requirements: frontmatter fields, negative-form prohibitions, write restrictions, allowlist
Defense in depth table: Agent boundary, role constraint, allowlist, physical deny
Invoking other skills via the Skill tool; no self-invocation to avoid infinite loops
Do not wait for Agent completion with ScheduleWakeup; end the turn and await notification
tasks: Writing or reviewing a SKILL.md that launches Agents
Choosing a launch route for delegated processing
Designing a plugin composed of SKILLs and Agents
Writing an Agent prompt or SKILL arguments
Defining write boundaries and allowlists for Agents
title: Claude Code 作成ガイド（SKILL / カスタム Agent）
